title: Direct and inverse image along a closed immersion reflects finite generation of modules
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that for a morphism of ringed spaces which is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset with surjective structural map, a module is of finite type exactly when its direct image is (author lemma at source lines 2115-2123, label lemma-i-star-reflects-finite-type). The proof (source lines 2125-2160) treats the points outside and inside the closed subset separately and reduces both directions to the behaviour of the displayed generating maps on stalks, using the surjectivity of the structural map at the points of the closed subset (proof lines 2129-2143 and 2145-2159). Both directions are proved by the same stalkwise inspection, and no reference external to the span is used. H2.
